## Welcome to my academic website

#### I am a researcher in **Mathematical Analysis**, with particular emphasis on partial differential equations, dynamical systems, and problems arising in mathematical physics.

#### I am currently a researcher at the Department of Mathematics, Università di Torino, Italy.
